title: Monocular and Stereo Cues for Landing Zone Evaluation for Micro UAVs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of safe landing for UAVs using monocular and stereo cues. While it mentions 'safety' as an important factor, this refers to the technical safety of the drone's operation and preventing physical damage, not an evaluation or benchmarking of ethical, moral, or religious considerations related to the AI system itself or its broader societal impact.
